about_the_game:
Inspired by the arcade classics, VR Blasteroids throws you into the vastness of outer space with full 6DOF movement and intuitive controls. Face wave after wave of asteroids and enemy drones while collecting powerups for your ship, unlocking warp gate puzzles, and attacking your highest score.

Features:

  • Intense VR battles

  • Multiple enemy types

  • Story and Arcade modes

  • Sci-Fi inspired soundtrack

  • High Score Attack

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 21H2 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen or later), AMD Ryzen 5 3600X 6-Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 (8 GB GDDR5X VRAM), Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus Rift S
  • Additional Notes: USB ports: At least 1 × USB 3.0 and 1 × USB 2.0
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit (Home or Pro, Version 22H2 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (8th Gen, e.g. i7-8700), Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060, Radeon RX 6800+
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus Rift S
  • Additional Notes: USB ports: USB-C, USB 3.1+, and DisplayPort/HDMI for VR headset support

short_description: Classic arcade action reimagined for virtual reality! Dodge, blast, and survive as you pilot your ship through swarms of asteroids and enemy drones in fully immersive 360° space battles.
